expanded_title: Spooky Takes 7-2 Up Against Kyle’s Pocket Aces in a Wild $20K Pot on Champions Club Live
expanded_deck: Spooky raises to $250 in the cutoff with seven-deuce offsuit (7♥ 2♦) right into Kyle's pocket aces (A♠ A♦) on the button — setting up a wild $20,000 pot on the Champions Club Live stream.
expanded_body:
Originally posted October 2, 2026.

Spooky takes 7-2 up against Kyle's pocket aces in a wild $20,000 pot on the Champions Club Live broadcast!

With deep five-figure stacks across the feature table — Kyle sitting on $13.2K on the button, Spooky with $10.5K in the cutoff, Scott L with $10.7K in the hijack (holding 10♠ 8♥ after calling $50), and RamseyTheRam with $8.6K — Spooky decided to turn up the heat preflop by raising to $250 with 7♥ 2♦, only to look straight into Kyle waking up with A♠ A♦ on the button.

Watch the full $20,000 clash on Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/reel/1985887152094115/) — would you have played it differently?

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
